newsitem.title: FRANCE: France delivering Mirage jets to Taiwan - Monde.
newsitem.headline: France delivering Mirage jets to Taiwan - Monde.

text.p: France has discreetly started delivering 60 Mirage 200O-5 fighters to Taiwan as part of a 1992 deal which caused uproar in Franco-Chinese relations, the newspaper Le Monde said on Wednesday.
The French Defence Ministry declined to comment on the report, which said the planes were being sent by sea in ships which changed flags and crews at an unspecified port en route.
The usually well-informed daily said 1,200 air-to-air Mica missiles were also being delivered.
The report came a month ahead of a visit to China by French Defence Minister Charles Millon. President Jacques Chirac is due to visit Beijing in May.
